text: {"lessons":["Buying 50 shares of each stock used a substantial amount of cash at once; next time I should size purchases deliberately and keep enough cash for flexibility.","Holding through the later ups and downs avoided reactive trading, but I should review my holdings against a consistent plan rather than assume holding is always best.","My account is still below its Period 1 value despite a rebound, so I should track progress over a longer horizon and keep my apartment goal and risk tolerance in view."]}
